# Tides

Self-written test material for groundcast.

## What causes tides

Tides are the regular rise and fall of the sea. They are caused mainly by the
pull of the Moon's gravity, with a smaller pull from the Sun.

## Spring and neap tides

When the Sun, the Moon, and the Earth line up, their pulls add together and
the tides are larger. These are called spring tides. When the Sun and the Moon
pull at right angles, the tides are smaller. These are called neap tides.

Most coasts have two high tides and two low tides every day.
